Hello, I am a very interested in your work. I like your work so much that I contacted you to request a commission 💕🫶🏻

What I would like to request is an illustration related to a PC x NPC in a Chinese TRPG module [Meikyo Zanshun].
Their relationship is childhood friend x lover, and the background is set in a high school in the Showa era. Their emotions are completely pure beauty and sincerity, and if I can depict the tragic nature of their story, or the innocent cruelty, I would be very excited about that as well.

**A girl with short brown curly hair and red eyes**
**Yuki Kyogoku (eternal 17 years old) (height 156cm)**
A girl who is bright, frank and full of boundless vitality. Dog-like. She never gives up, but has a girlish, shy, nervous, and clumsy side. Her parents live in a shrine, where she is also an apprentice miko. She has been a "knight protecting Onodera" since she was a child and considers Onodera to be the cutest friend she has ever met. He sometimes teases Onodera and likes to watch her embarrassment when she gets friendly with him. At school, Onodera is the head of the Kaiyodo Investigation Club, and although Onodera is the only member, he is actively involved in the club's activities! His goal is to collect all 7 wonders of the school before graduation!

---Onodera is the only member of the club, and he is actively involved in the club!

**Girl with white twin-tail hair and eyes partially hidden by bangs**
**Noriko Onodera (age 17-?) (Height 154cm)**
A timid, shy girl who is not good at socializing. Because of her bangs and stiff smile, she is always seen as gloomy and ghostly. She is isolated and ostracized throughout the school. She is called the "ghost girl of class 3-B," but in reality she is a very screwed-up girl with no malicious intent. Her only hobby is to appreciate different flavors of bread and sweets. The rest of the time, she reads romance novels and contemplates unrealistic love stories. Having yin-yang eyes, she has been able to see various kinds of weird things since she was a little girl, and has been protected by her childhood friends ever since she was a little girl. From the bottom of his heart, he thinks Kyogoku is like an angel, and he is Kyogoku's enthusiastic guesser (a very strong guesser). He is mean and cowardly, but he is willing to pay the price of his life to protect those he cares about.
